name: motion-blur
author: the motion-blur authors
_comment: Pinned to OBS 30.0 deliberately. libobs rejects a plugin whose major.minor exceeds the host's (patch is masked off), so building against the OLDEST supported release is what makes one binary load on 30, 31 and 32. obs_encoder_set_frame_rate_divisor, which the decimate mode depends on, dates to the 30.x line and sets that floor.
